elements.title: Header
elements.fulfilled_by: process-map/<name>.json › meta: kicker, title, client and date

elements.title: Lanes
elements.fulfilled_by: process-map/<name>.json › lanes[] {id, label}: at least one, each a role

elements.title: Steps with owners
elements.fulfilled_by: process-map/<name>.json › nodes[]: at least one step, each in the lane of the role that owns it, with its owner, state and cite (only a gap-state step may leave owner out: its gap card says what is missing)

elements.title: Flows
elements.fulfilled_by: process-map/<name>.json › edges[] {from, to}: every node joined to the flow, and at least one edge when the map has two or more nodes; a step whose order no source states is listed instead by a clarification with order: true that asks where it comes

elements.title: Gaps card
elements.fulfilled_by: process-map/<name>.json › gaps[] {id, title, text, nodes, cite}: at least one, proven by an absent search; or, when no step is in gap state and every step's owner and outcome is in a record it cites (a step whose order no record states is asked by an order clarification instead), one None found card {id, title, text, none: true, nodes: [], cite} that cites those records, grounded or inferred

elements.title: Clarifications card
elements.fulfilled_by: process-map/<name>.json › clarifications[] {id, title, shows, ask, nodes, cite}: at least one; or one None found card (none: true, nodes: []) that cites why nothing is left to confirm, grounded or inferred

elements.title: Citation points section, with in-place markers
elements.fulfilled_by: computed by build_map.py from every cite in the file: one numbered marker (a.cp-mk) on each cited element, and section#citation-points with one li.cp-row per point the page uses

elements.title: System key
elements.fulfilled_by: process-map/<name>.json › systems[] {id, label, icon, cite}, with nodes[].systems

elements.title: Views band
elements.fulfilled_by: process-map/<name>.json › groups[] {id, label}: two or more, with nodes[].group
